captions.detailed: A 3D model of a go-kart rear live axle assembly. It features a long, dark-grey cylindrical axle tube supported by two pillow-block bearing mounts on a black rectangular frame. Mounted on the axle are two light-grey wheel hubs at each end, complete with four small mounting studs, and a central light-grey drive sprocket with defined teeth. The entire axle assembly, including the wheel hubs and sprocket, is designed to rotate continuously relative to the fixed black support frame.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a go-kart rear live axle assembly in CadQuery. The model should include a central rotating axle tube supported by two pillow-block bearing blocks on a black rectangular frame, with a central drive sprocket and two wheel hubs with studs at either end of the axle.
captions.factory: The assembly is constructed using multiple parts. The fixed base frame is built using box primitives for the rectangular frame and cylinders for the support tubes. The rotating axle is created as a long cylinder. The sprocket is modeled by combining a central cylinder with repeated box patterns rotated around its axis to form the teeth. The wheel hubs are made of flat cylinders with four smaller cylindrical studs extruded from their faces. Pillow blocks are modeled using box and cylinder operations, and the parts are assembled with a continuous rotational joint defined between the base frame and the axle.
